title: Medical Expense Amount of the Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter
content:
**Amount stated.** The annual letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** for the year just ended states the plan's entrance fee medical expense percentage of the entrance fee received on the agreement's ledger in the tax year plus the plan's monthly fee medical expense percentage of the payments posted to the resident's independent living ledger in the tax year, rounded to the cent half up; for a January issue the tax year's entries are those posted 1 to 12 whole months before the issue date, that is at least 1 and fewer than 13 whole months before it.

The two portions are added together before the single rounding to the cent half up.

**Plans at 0.0.** A plan whose medical expense percentages are both 0.0 receives an annual letter stating 0.00, whatever entries the window holds.

## Inputs

| Portion | Entries counted | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Entrance fee portion | Deposit and balance payments on the agreement's ledger | The plan's entrance fee medical expense percentage |
| Monthly fee portion | Payments posted to the resident's Independent Living Residency Agreement ledger | The plan's monthly fee medical expense percentage |

## Worked figures (hypothetical, LifeCare Declining Balance Plan percentages 34.6 and 38.5)

| Entrance fee received in the window | Independent living payments in the window | Entrance fee portion | Monthly fee portion | Amount stated |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 50400.00 | 0.00 | 19404.00 | 19404.00 |
| 37765.00 | 8400.00 | 13066.69 | 3234.00 | 16300.69 |

Under any of the four LifeChoice plans the same entries give a letter stating 0.00.
